Contango, injection building surplus (0507 print consensus +74) - fundamentals still bearish. BUT this is a Wednesday and I RUN the mid-block right-the-ship re-check: D-1 (0505 Tue) tape FLIPPED to BUY - signed_flow +3258, session_b 0.50, big_print_b 0.521 (a genuine buy session right after 0504's -3110 sell). Turn stack: (i) 0429 big-print buy-absorption 0.621 + 0505 0.521 (spaced buy-absorption, one clean + one near-miss), (ii) COT extreme short at 10.38 1y pctile and COVERING (mm_net -100.6k->-97.2k = shorts being squeezed out under an extreme), (iii) a fresh single-session bounce 0505. So I UNLOCK to TURN-PENDING and take the sign to the turn side: flat-to-UP, p50 +100. Genuine BIMODAL day (down-continuation vs turn) - emitting both components.
